items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: he had all the good jobs that ever came through there. And I think I was fortunate he liked me.

ctx.x: Normally you couldn't get off the campus?

You could get off the campus up to a certain time. See I'm under, see I'm a boy around 12, 13, 14, 15, 16. I say right about this time I'm 14 years old and you had to account for yourself. Tremendous idea because the parents send you there, therefore, people and the president are responsible and he's got to know. It was a wonderful idea. And Bud Rankin and his family, they were -- he was the one who was musical ... he had all the good jobs that ever came through there. And I think I was fortunate he liked me.…
